usage: llm-modelbench simulate [-h] [--run-dir RUN_DIR]
                               [--simulate-vram SIMULATE_VRAM] [--json]
                               {repair-watch} ...

positional arguments:
  {repair-watch}
    repair-watch        replay deterministic repair status transitions without
                        Ollama or GPU work

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-dir RUN_DIR     legacy: finished run directory containing
                        raw_results.jsonl
  --simulate-vram SIMULATE_VRAM
                        legacy: hypothetical VRAM budget in GB
  --json
